name: Greenworks (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd.
summary: Greenworks (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of garden machinery in China and internationally. The company offers lawn mowers and blowers; garden and power tools; lithium battery products; cleaning machines; push mowers; hair dryers; pruning machines; chain saws; and smart zero-turn mounts. It sells its products under the Greenworks, Powerworks, Cramer, and Greenworks Commercial brands through online. The company serves supermarkets and e-commerce partners.
